name: socialcrawl-mcp
description: Access 48 platforms and 381 endpoints through one unified API — social media, commerce & product reviews, retail (Amazon, Walmart, Target, Home Depot, eBay, Google Shopping), app stores (Google Play, App Store), places & travel (Tripadvisor, Google Business/Hotels), business reputation (Trustpilot), web research (Tavily, Perplexity), full web scraping & browser automation (scrape, crawl, agent, monitors, sessions), Korean search (Naver + Data Lab), content/sentiment analysis, Google News/Finance/Trends, GitHub, Hacker News, Polymarket, AI X-search via Grok, cross-platform Prism composites, and a universal /search/everywhere meta-search — with exact per-endpoint credit pricing (ladder, flat, and metered bands) for every one.
